comments.text: The consumers of America need your help Bailey.   If you buy a car with "ALL WhEEL Drive" they are ripping YOU off.  Those vehicles REALLY have 4 wheel drive.  A vehicle with all wheel drive would have 5 wheel drive.  The wheel on a jeep that has the spare tire on it is NOT driven.  Were the spare mounted on a transversely mounted 5th wheel, it could descend and lift the rear tires off the road.  You can get such a car in a much smaller space than a 4 wheel drive car.
